description.p: 860 Control brings the features of gaming keyboards and mice to the GNOME desktop, where the system has no settings for them.

For the Logitech G512 keyboard: lighting effects, per-key Custom and Gaming key maps, and the Gaming map while a game runs. For the G502 HERO mouse: lighting, DPI steps, report rate, onboard profiles and button actions. The app talks to the g512d service, which owns the devices and keeps their settings after replugs and suspend.
